instruction: Navigate to the Criminal Division forms page on the Justice Department website.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Criminal Division (ID 432) forms page. Uses same evaluator pattern as original (Civil Division ID 431) to check URL pattern match.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies navigation to Criminal Division forms page using URL pattern matching
Getter (active_url_from_accessTree) appropriately extracts active Chrome tab URL for navigation verification
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly uses regex to check if URL contains expected pattern 'forms\?title=&field_component_target_id=432'
Expected value semantically correct - targets Criminal Division (ID 432) vs original Civil Division (ID 431)
Complete coverage - verifying URL pattern is sufficient to confirm user reached the correct forms page
Data flow is correct: accessibility tree → active URL → regex pattern match → verification result
No postconfig needed - navigation state persists in browser URL
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: URL pattern 'forms\?title=&field_component_target_id=432' assumes exact query parameter structure. Consider using a more flexible pattern like 'field_component_target_id=432' if website URL structure changes (e.g., removes empty title parameter). Current pattern should work but may be brittle to minor URL changes.
